app.name: Budgee
app.description: Track income and spending, offline first, synced between your devices.
update.available: A new version of Budgee is ready.
app.storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable in this browser window, so Budgee cannot open. Try a regular (not private) window.
sync.notPairedHint: Entries stay on this device until you pair it.
sync.notPairedAction: Not paired. Open Settings to pair this device.
sync.offlineHint: Changes stay on this device until it is back online.
sync.revokedHint: This device was removed from sync. Pair it again in Settings.
sync.revokedAction: Device removed from sync. Open Settings to pair it again.
sync.error.unauthorized: The server does not recognize this device.
sync.error.server: The server ran into a problem. Sync will try again.
sync.error.badResponse: The server sent an answer this app does not understand.
sync.error.decrypt: Synced data could not be decrypted ({table} {id}). This device may have the wrong vault key.
sync.error.rowTooLarge: An entry is too large to sync ({table} {id}). Shorten its note or detail.
sync.error.internal: Something went wrong on this device. Sync will try again.
sync.announce.offline: Offline. Changes stay on this device until it is back online.
list.title: Entries
list.emptyMonthHint: Entries you add for this month show up here.
list.emptyFilteredHint: Try another search, or clear the filters to see the whole month.
filter.noTags: No tags on this month's entries.
add.title: New entry
edit.title: Edit entry
entry.rateHint: 1 {currency} = {rate} {main}, your rate from the last {currency} entry. The {main} amount stays editable so it can match what your bank actually charged.
entry.noRateHint: No earlier {currency} entry, so type the {main} amount by hand.
entry.tagsNote: · optional, to group entries across categories
entry.deleteBody: It disappears from the list, and from your other devices once they sync.
entry.discardBody: The changes you made to this entry will be lost.
entry.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, here or on another device.
entry.loadErrorHint: Go back to the list and try again.
entry.errorAmountZero: The amount must be more than zero.
entry.errorAmountWhole: Use a whole amount, without decimals.
entry.errorAmountDecimals: Too many digits after the decimal point (at most {count}).
entry.errorForm: Something in this entry isn't valid. Check the fields and try again.
entry.errorSave: The entry couldn't be saved. Try again.
entry.errorDelete: The entry couldn't be deleted. Try again.
entry.deletedElsewhere: This entry was deleted on another device, so these changes can't be saved.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.compareRangeAverage: {current} against the average of the 12 months before
dashboard.excludeHint: Entries in a chosen category, or with a chosen tag, are left out of the cards and of every chart that uses the dashboard's exclusions.
dashboard.excludeError: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
dashboard.chartEmpty: Nothing to show for this period.
dashboard.emptyHint: Add a few entries and the dashboard fills in.
dashboard.emptyPeriodHint: The cards count from zero; charts over longer periods still show.
dashboard.layoutHint: Move charts up or down. Each move is saved at once.
dashboard.removeBody: The chart leaves the dashboard on every device. Your entries stay as they are.
dashboard.removeError: The chart couldn't be removed. Try again.
dashboard.moveError: The new order couldn't be saved. Try again.
dashboard.noCharts: No charts on the dashboard. Add one from the suggestions.
addChart.title: Add chart
addChart.intro: Start from a suggestion. Every one opens in the chart editor, so you can change the grouping, comparison and exclusions.
addChart.yearOverYearHint: Each month this year against the same month last year
addChart.keptOfIncomeHint: Share of income you didn't spend, month by month
addChart.byTagHint: Spending by tag over the last 12 months, untagged entries together
addChart.monthPaceHint: Spent so far this month vs your usual month, day by day
addChart.tripTotalHint: Everything tagged with one trip, like Istanbul 2026, by category
addChart.biggestChangesHint: Your top categories against last year, so rises and drops stand out
addChart.topDetailsHint: Where the money goes: AliExpress, dentist, Carrefour…
addChart.spendingCalendarHint: What you spent each day of the period
addChart.byWeekdayHint: Spending by day of the week over the last 12 months
addChart.incomeSourcesHint: Salary vs side income over the last 12 months
chartEdit.name: Name
chartEdit.metricTable: A table shows income, expenses and kept for each row.
chartEdit.compareAllTime: All time has no earlier period to compare with.
chartEdit.compareKind: Only bars and lines show a comparison.
chartEdit.cumulativeHint: Each day, month or year adds to the ones before
chartEdit.limitHint: The rest are added up as Other
chartEdit.countsHint: Untick anything to leave it out of this chart only.
chartEdit.dashboardNothing: The dashboard leaves nothing out right now
chartEdit.onlyTaggedHint: When set, the chart counts only entries with one of these tags.
chartEdit.errorSave: The chart couldn't be saved. Try again.
chartEdit.errorRemove: The chart couldn't be removed. Try again.
chartEdit.deletedElsewhere: This chart was removed on another device, so it can't be saved.
chartEdit.notFound: This chart isn't on the dashboard any more.
chartEdit.notFoundHint: It may have been removed on another device.
chartEdit.loadErrorHint: Go back to the dashboard and try again.
chartEdit.discardBody: Your changes to this chart will be lost.
settings.title: Settings
settings.currencyConfirmBody: Amounts are relabelled, not converted: {before} will show as {after}. Use this to fix the label, not to switch currencies.
settings.saveFailed: The setting couldn't be saved. Try again.
settings.tagsMeta: {count} in use · rename, merge or delete
settings.connectMeta: First device: set up your server with its setup secret
settings.pairDeviceMeta: Scan its QR code or paste its pairing link
settings.restoreKeyMeta: A new device, when your server already has data
settings.syncUnpairedNote: Budgee works fully on this device. Connecting is optional: it syncs your devices and enables backups.
settings.revokedNote: This device was removed from sync. Forget the pairing, then pair it again.
settings.driveHint: Daily encrypted copies, made by the server
settings.serverLater: Available after connecting to a server.
settings.encryptionText: Your entries are encrypted on this device. The server and Google Drive only store scrambled data.
settings.encryptionWarning: If you lose every device and the recovery key, nobody can read your data.
settings.exportCsvMeta: Simple or full (with id and clock)
settings.liveCsvOff: Keep a CSV copy on this computer, rewritten after every change
backups.notConfiguredHint: Backups to Google Drive aren't set up on this server. Whoever runs it must set the server's Google credentials (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, CONFIG_KEY and PUBLIC_ORIGIN). You can still restore from a backup file.
backups.reconnectHint: Google stopped accepting this connection (access was removed or has expired), so backups are paused. Reconnect Google Drive to resume them.
backups.unpairedNote: Backups are made by your server, so connect to one first. You can restore from a backup file now.
backups.disconnectBody: Daily backups stop. The backups already in the budgee-backups folder in your Drive stay there.
backups.disconnected: Google Drive disconnected. Backups are off.
backups.failure.reconnect: Google Drive access was removed or has expired. Reconnect Google Drive.
backups.failure.refused: Google Drive refused the file: it may be full, or Budgee no longer has permission to use its folder.
backups.failure.notFound: The budgee-backups folder was removed from Google Drive. It's created again at the next backup.
backups.failure.unavailable: Google Drive had a problem or couldn't be reached. It's tried again at the next backup.
backups.failure.other: Something went wrong. It's tried again at the next backup.
backups.retentionError: The backup was saved, but old backups couldn't be removed. {reason}
backups.filesError: The backups in Drive couldn't be listed. {reason}
backups.downloadHint: To restore, download a backup from the budgee-backups folder in Google Drive, then choose Restore…
backups.error.offline: Can't reach the server at {host}. Backups will show once you're online.
backups.return.connected: Google Drive is connected. Backups run every day.
backups.return.invalidState: Connecting didn't finish: that Google sign-in was already used, or a newer one replaced it. Choose Connect Google Drive again.
backups.return.expired: The Google sign-in took longer than 10 minutes. Choose Connect Google Drive again.
backups.return.denied: Google Drive wasn't connected: access was declined on Google's page.
backups.return.googleError: Google couldn't finish the sign-in. Try again in a moment.
backups.return.exchangeFailed: The server couldn't finish connecting to Google. Try again in a moment.
backups.return.noRefreshToken: Google didn't grant lasting access. Remove Budgee under Third-party access in your Google account, then connect again.
backups.return.missingScope: Google Drive access wasn't granted. Connect again and tick the box that lets Budgee use Google Drive.
backups.return.failed: Google Drive couldn't be connected. Try again.
restoreBackup.title: Restore from backup
restoreBackup.intro: Choose a backup downloaded from the budgee-backups folder in Google Drive. It's merged with what's on this device: for each entry the most recent change wins, so nothing newer here is overwritten.
restoreBackup.keyHint: This device isn't paired, so it has no key yet. Enter the recovery key of the data the backup was made from.
restoreBackup.error.notBackup: This isn't a Budgee backup. Choose a budgee-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz file.
restoreBackup.error.wrongKey: This backup was made with a different key, or the file is damaged. Restore it on a device that has that recovery key.
restoreBackup.error.wrongRecoveryKey: This recovery key doesn't open this backup, or the file is damaged. Check the key, or choose another file.
restoreBackup.error.damaged: This backup file is damaged and can't be restored. Try another one.
restoreBackup.error.tooLarge: This file is over 200 MB, too large to be a Budgee backup. Choose a budgee-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz file.
restoreBackup.error.unknown: The file couldn't be read. Try again.
restoreBackup.error.saveFailed: The restore couldn't be saved on this device, so nothing changed. Free up some storage, then try again.
restoreBackup.empty: This backup file holds no records, so there is nothing to restore. Choose another file.
restoreBackup.changesOne: 1 item will change on this device.
restoreBackup.changesMany: {count} items will change on this device.
restoreBackup.changesNone: This device already has everything in this backup.
restoreBackup.keepsNewer: Anything changed here since the backup stays as it is.
restoreBackup.localOnly: Restored items stay on this device until you connect to a server.
restoreBackup.doneNone: Nothing needed restoring: this device was already up to date.
pairing.error.invalidUrl: Enter the server's full address, starting with https://.
pairing.error.otherServer: This pairing link is for a different server than the one at {host}.
pairing.error.keyMismatch: This recovery key doesn't match the data on the server.
pairing.error.alreadySetUp: This server is already set up. Pair this device from one that uses it, or restore with your recovery key.
pairing.error.setupDisabled: Setup is turned off on this server: it has no setup secret.
pairing.error.invalidCode: This pairing code is wrong or has expired. Make a new one on your other device.
pairing.error.offline: Can't reach the server at {host}. Check the address and your connection.
pairing.error.notBudgee: The server at {host} didn't answer like a Budgee server. Check the address.
pairing.error.rateLimited: Too many attempts from this network. Wait a minute and try again.
pairing.error.checkFailed: The recovery key couldn't be checked: the server stopped answering. This device was taken off the server again. Get a new pairing code and try again.
pairing.error.unverified: Restore cancelled. This device was taken off the server again; get a new pairing code to try again.
pairing.error.saveFailedPair: This device couldn't save the pairing, so it was taken off the server again. Free up some storage, then pair again with a new code.
pairing.error.saveFailed: The server accepted this device, but the pairing couldn't be saved here, often because storage is full. Nothing is lost: the server is waiting for this device. Free up some space, then try saving again. Don't run setup again; the server would refuse it.
pairing.error.saveFailedAgain: Still couldn't save. Free up some storage (or close other tabs), then try again.
pairing.connectIntro: For your first device. The server's setup secret claims it for you; after that, other devices pair from this one.
pairing.serverUrlHint: Where Budgee is installed. It's usually this page's address.
pairing.setupSecretHint: The SETUP_SECRET set when the server was deployed. It works once, for the first device.
pairing.deviceNameHint: Shown in your device list. You can rename it later.
pairing.alreadyPaired: This device is already paired with {host}.
pairing.alreadyPairedHint: To pair it with another server, first forget the pairing in Settings → Sync and devices. Your entries stay on this device.
recovery.saveText: This key unlocks your encrypted data. Save it in a password manager, or print it and keep it somewhere safe. Later it's shown only in Settings → Encryption, on a paired device.
recovery.warning: If you lose every device and this key, nobody can read your data or backups, including you. There is no reset.
recovery.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.
recovery.qrLabel: Recovery key as a QR code
recovery.savedCheck: I saved my recovery key somewhere safe
recovery.continueHint: Tick the box once the key is saved.
recovery.confirmBody: Anyone with this key can read your backups. Make sure nobody can see your screen.
recovery.failed: The key couldn't be read on this device.
recovery.title: Recovery key
recovery.dialogText: Keep it in a password manager. With your server or a backup, it unlocks your data on a new device.
pair.title: Pair this device
pair.intro: Join the server your other devices use. On a paired device, open Settings → Add device with QR code.
pair.scanHint: The camera turns on only after you tap the button.
pair.pasteHint: Use Copy link on the other device and paste it here.
pair.restoreNote: No paired device at hand, but you have the recovery key?
pair.notLink: That isn't a pairing link. Copy it again from the other device.
pair.incomplete: This pairing link is incomplete. Copy it again from the other device.
pair.badKey: This pairing link has a damaged key. Copy it again from the other device.
pair.otherOrigin: This link is for {linkHost}, but this app runs on {appHost}. For your safety it can't be used here.
pair.insecure: This link is for {host} without a secure (https) connection, so it can't be used.
restore.unverifiedTitle: Use a key the server can't check?
restore.unverifiedBody: Your server has no data yet, so it can't confirm this recovery key. Data saved with a wrong key can't be read by your other devices. Double-check the key before you go on.
pair.confirmText: It will sync with {host}. Entries already on this device join the shared data.
scan.pointAt: Point the camera at the QR code on your other device.
scan.notPairing: That QR code isn't a pairing link.
scan.denied: Camera access was denied. Paste the pairing link instead.
scan.noCamera: No camera is available. Paste the pairing link instead.
scan.failed: The camera couldn't start. Paste the pairing link instead.
restore.title: Restore with recovery key
restore.intro: For a new device when your server already has your data. The server still needs to let this device in: use a pairing code from a paired device, or the setup secret on a fresh server.
restore.codeHint: Shown under the QR code in Settings → Add device with QR code. Valid 10 minutes.
restore.secretHint: Only for a server with no devices yet.
restore.recoveryKeyHint: 14 groups of 4 letters and digits. Case, spaces and dashes don't matter.
restore.keyLength: This recovery key is too short or too long. Check that all 14 groups are there.
restore.keyCharacter: This recovery key has a character recovery keys don't use. Check for typos.
restore.keyChecksum: This recovery key doesn't check out. Look for a typo.
addDevice.title: Add a device
addDevice.scanHint: Scan this code with the new device's camera, or open Budgee there and choose Pair with another device.
addDevice.codeHint: Restoring with a recovery key instead? Type this code on the new device.
addDevice.expiredHint: This code expired. Make a new one.
addDevice.linkWarning: The link holds your encryption key. Send it only to yourself, and never post it anywhere.
addDevice.copied: Link copied. It holds your encryption key.
devices.name: Name
devices.revokeBody: It stops syncing at once and can only join again with a new pairing code. Entries already on it stay there.
devices.revokeSelfBody: This is the device you're using. It stops syncing with {host} right away.
devices.revokeSelfConfirmBody: Your entries stay here. To sync this device again, pair it with a new code from one of your other devices.
devices.revokedSelf: This device was revoked. Its entries stay here.
devices.onlyDevice: This is the only device on the server, so it can't be revoked: nothing could pair with the server again. Pair another device first.
devices.lastDeviceError: This is the only device left on the server, so it can't be revoked. Pair another device first.
devices.forgetTitle: Forget the pairing on this device?
devices.forgetBody: This device stops syncing with {host}. Your entries stay here. The server keeps listing it until you revoke it from another device.
devices.forgotten: Pairing forgotten. Entries stay on this device.
lists.categoriesIntro: Every entry has one category from its type's list. Archived categories stay on older entries but aren't offered for new ones.
lists.name: Name
lists.lastHint: It's the only active one, and new entries need one to choose, so it stays.
lists.mergeBody: {entries} will move from “{name}” to “{target}”, then “{name}” is deleted.
lists.mergeBodyNone: No entries use “{name}”, so none change; “{name}” is deleted.
lists.deleteBody: No entries use “{name}”, so none change.
lists.inUseBody: “{name}” is on {entries}, so it can't be deleted. Merge it into another one to move those entries, or archive it to keep it on them but stop offering it.
lists.inUseBodyArchived: “{name}” is on {entries}, so it can't be deleted. Merge it into another one to move those entries.
lists.errorTaken: That name is already in the list.
lists.errorTakenByIncome: That name is already an income category. Each name can be used once.
lists.errorTakenByExpense: That name is already an expense category. Each name can be used once.
lists.errorMissing: This changed on another device. Close and try again.
lists.errorInUse: Entries use it, so it can't be deleted.
lists.errorLast: It's the only active one, so it stays.
lists.errorSave: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
tags.intro: Tags come from your entries. Renaming, merging or deleting one updates every entry that carries it.
tags.emptyHint: Add a tag to an entry to group it across categories, like a trip.
tags.collideBody: “{target}” already exists (tags ignore case). Saving merges “{name}” into it: {entries} will change.
tags.deleteBody: “{name}” will be removed from {entries}. The entries stay.
tags.deleteChartsOne: 1 chart only shows entries with this tag; it will show nothing until you edit it.
tags.deleteChartsMany: {count} charts only show entries with this tag; they will show nothing until you edit them.
tags.errorSave: The change couldn't be saved. Try again.
dev.title: Developer
dev.demoHint: Adds the mockups' sample entries. Works on a fresh, unpaired install.
dev.demoPaired: This device is paired, so demo data stays out.
dev.resetHint: Deletes this device's database and reloads.
dev.prefillConnect: Fill in Connect to a server
dev.prefillHint: Opens the real Connect form with this secret filled in (kept in memory only).
liveFile.paused: Allow access again to keep {name} up to date
liveFile.denied: Access wasn't allowed. Allow it, or stop and choose the file again.
liveFile.failed: {name} couldn't be written. It may be open in another app.
liveFile.pickFailed: The file couldn't be used. Try again, or choose another one.
liveFile.note: A full CSV (with id and clock), so it can be imported back.
liveFile.started: {name} is now kept up to date.
export.title: Export CSV
export.fullMeta: Adds id and clock, so importing it back updates entries instead of adding them again
export.empty: There are no entries to export here.
export.failed: The file couldn't be saved. Try again.
import.title: Import CSV
import.intro: Choose a CSV file whose first line names its columns. Exports from Budgee are matched automatically; other files can be matched by hand.
import.fileHint: Comma separated, UTF-8, amounts with a dot for decimals (12.50).
import.error.tooLarge: This file is over 10 MB, too large to import. Split it into smaller files.
import.error.empty: This file has no rows to import. Its first line should name the columns, with the rows under it.
import.error.unterminatedQuote: Line {line} opens a quote that is never closed. Fix the file, then choose it again.
import.error.textAfterQuote: Line {line} has text right after a closing quote. Fix the file, then choose it again.
import.error.unreadable: The file couldn't be read. Try again.
import.columnsIntro: Columns were matched by their names. Check them, then continue.
import.missing: Choose the column that holds it.
import.missingSummary: Some required fields have no column: {fields}.
import.firstRows: The first {count} rows of the file.
import.problemRows: Every row with an error or a warning.
import.errorsHint: Rows with errors are skipped. To import them, fix the file and choose it again.
import.duplicatesHint: A possible duplicate has the same date, amount, type and category as an entry you have or an earlier row. It's imported anyway.
import.noneReady: No row can be imported. Fix the file, or match the columns differently.
import.issue.date: Date isn't a date written as YYYY-MM-DD.
import.issue.type: Type must be income or expense.
import.issue.amount: {field} must be a number above 0 with a dot for decimals, like 12.50.
import.issue.hlc: Clock (hlc) isn't a valid clock value.
import.issue.pairOriginal: Original amount and original currency go together: fill in both or neither.
import.issue.idWithoutHlc: This row has an id but no clock (hlc). Rows with an id need both to merge.
import.issue.hlcWithoutId: This row has a clock (hlc) but no id. Fill in both or neither.
import.issue.currency: Original currency isn't a known currency code, like EUR.
import.newNamesHint: These aren't in your lists yet and will be added. Untick one to leave out the rows that use it.
import.skippedRepeated: Skipped, same id on a newer row
import.mergeHint: Rows with an id merge like a sync: the most recent change wins, so nothing newer here is overwritten.
import.nothingToDo: Nothing to import: every row is skipped or already up to date here.
import.saveFailed: The import couldn't be saved, so nothing changed. Try again.
import.doneNone: Nothing changed: this device already had everything in the file.
liveFile.stopFailed: The file couldn't be forgotten. Try again.
import.pairHint: Rows with only one of original amount and original currency often mean a column was matched by mistake. If the file has no amounts paid in another currency, set those fields to “Not in the file”.
